text_en: Hey, is it really true that you and Adamont were trapped and escaped from a pyramid in the desert?
Putting up with Adamont, I mean.
There's no captain in all of Zarga grumpier than him. He wouldn't know how to have fun if his life depended on it.
Actually, sorry, I think there is one situation which I've seen him enjoy.
When he has to bash someone's head in.
